title: Baked Eggplant Pasta
description: A delicious and easy Italian dish made with eggplant and pasta, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine sliced eggplant and 1 tbsp (15ml) of oil. Toss to coat.
3. Spread eggplant slices on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
4. Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
5. In a large skillet, combine cooked pasta, roasted eggplant, and remaining 1 tbsp (15ml) of oil.
6. Season with italian seasonings to taste.
